fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you? Welcome to www.lazychinese.com.

fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你的故事叫望梅止渴
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you a story called 'Wang Mei Zhi Ke'.
'Wang Mei Zhi Ke' is a Chinese idiom.

fullTextZH: 成语这四个字不是很重要
fullTextEN: The four characters of the idiom are not very important.

fullTextZH: 但是这个故事很有趣哦
fullTextEN: But this story is very interesting.

fullTextZH: 现在来看我画图说故事吧
fullTextEN: Now let's watch me draw and tell the story.

fullTextZH: 在中国有一个有名的人叫曹操
fullTextEN: In China, there was a famous person named Cao Cao.
Once, Cao Cao led his soldiers.

fullTextZH: 他们要去很远很远的地方
fullTextEN: They were going to a very far place.
At that time, it was summer.

fullTextZH: 曹操和他的士兵走了很多天
fullTextEN: Cao Cao and his soldiers walked for many days.
Food and water were getting less and less.
But there were no houses along the way.
There are no people and no water.
The water was also all drunk.

fullTextZH: 越来越多的士兵倒下来死掉了
fullTextEN: More and more soldiers fell down and died.

fullTextZH: 曹操看他的士兵一个一个倒下来死了
fullTextEN: Cao Cao watched his soldiers fall down and die one by one.
He needed to quickly think of a solution.
So he rode a horse and ran forward.
He ran to the top of a mountain.

fullTextZH: 他想看看什么地方有水呢
fullTextEN: He wanted to see where there was water.
As a result, he didn't see any water.
Cao Cao thinks there's no water
Walk to a place with water

fullTextZH: 可是曹操看看他的士兵
fullTextEN: But Cao Cao looks at his soldiers

fullTextZH: 你要怎么样让士兵听你的话
fullTextEN: How would you make the soldiers listen to you?
Cao Cao thought of a method
He stood on a small hill

fullTextZH: 我看到前面有很多很多梅子树
fullTextEN: I see many plum trees ahead
Everyone quickly stand up and move forward.

fullTextZH: 现在你想一下酸酸甜甜的水果
fullTextEN: Now think about sweet and sour fruits.

fullTextZH: 你想到这些水果的时候
fullTextEN: When you think of these fruits,

fullTextZH: 你的嘴巴有没有口水呢
他们想到梅子酸酸甜甜的梅子
fullTextEN: They think of sour and sweet plums.
Cao Cao shouts encouragement from the front.
You can eat lots of plums.

fullTextZH: 最后他们走到了有水的地方
fullTextEN: Finally, they reached a place with water.

fullTextZH: 曹操和他的士兵可以休息了
fullTextEN: Cao Cao and his soldiers can rest now.

fullTextZH: 这就是望梅止渴的故事

fullTextEN: This is the story of 'quenching thirst by thinking of plums'.

words.gloss: quenching thirst by thinking of plums

fullTextEN: The meaning of 'quenching thirst by thinking of plums' is

fullTextZH: 你想象吃酸酸甜甜的梅子
fullTextEN: you imagine eating sour and sweet plums.
Then you don't feel thirsty anymore.

fullTextZH: 如果你很想去一个地方玩
fullTextEN: If you really want to go play somewhere,

fullTextZH: 那你可以看看夏威夷的照片
fullTextEN: then you can look at pictures of Hawaii.

fullTextEN: This is also 'quenching thirst by thinking of plums'.

fullTextZH: 现在你会用这个成语了吗
fullTextEN: Can you use this idiom now?

fullTextZH: 很多说中文的人也不太会说成语
fullTextEN: Many Chinese speakers also don't often use idioms.
We also don't use them often.
You can leave a message to tell me.

fullTextZH: 如果你很想要一个东西

fullTextEN: You will console yourself with illusions.

fullTextZH: 还是努力得到这个东西呢
fullTextEN: Or work hard to get this thing?
